unit.why: Two Torah teachings quoted from Likkutei Torah on Bamidbar (Reuben/Simeon, chesed/gevurah) and Ki Tavo (the confession of tithes), attributed to R. Yissachar Ber and R. Menahem Mendel of Rymanów, with no narrated events; it ends with the heading of the next section.
